analysis_md: 解答 令 $x=r\cos\theta,y=r\sin\theta$，则在 $D$ 中有 $0\leq\theta\leq\frac{\pi}{2},0\leq r\leq\frac{1}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}$，所以有 $\iint_Df(x,y)d\sigma=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{1}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)rdr$。
search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 在 $D:0\leq y\leq1-x,0\leq x\leq1$ 上连续，将 $\iint_Df(x,y)d\sigma$ 写成极坐标下的二次积分是[\quad] $\int_0^{\pi/2}d\theta\int_0^{1/(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)rdr$ $\int_0^{\pi/2}d\theta\int_0^{1-\cos\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)rdr$ $\int_0^{\pi/2}d\theta\int_0^1f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)rdr$ $\int_0^{\pi/2}d\theta\int_0^{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)rdr$ 解答 令 $x=r\cos\theta,y=r\sin\theta$，则在 $D$ 中有 $0\leq\theta\leq\frac{\pi}{2},0\leq r\leq\frac{1}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}$，所以有 $\iint_Df(x,y)d\sigma=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{1}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)rdr$。
